mapper.insert: insert into bbs_like (target_type, target_id, user_id, create_time) values (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{userId}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from bbs_like where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from bbs_like where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}

select p.post_id, p.category_id, p.user_id, p.title, cast(p.content as char) as content, p.summary, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.collect_count, p.is_top, p.is_essence, p.is_anonymous, p.is_admin_push, p.status, p.del_flag, p.last_reply_time, p.last_reply_user, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, c.category_name, case when p.is_anonymous = '1' then '匿名用户' else u.nick_name end as nick_name, case when p.is_anonymous = '1' then '' else u.avatar end as avatar from bbs_post p left join bbs_category c on p.category_id = c.category_id left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id inner join bbs_like l on p.post_id = l.target_id where l.user_id = #{userId} and l.target_type = '1' and p.del_flag = '0' order by l.create_time desc

select count(*) from bbs_like l left join bbs_post p on l.target_type = '1' and l.target_id = p.post_id left join bbs_comment c on l.target_type = '2' and l.target_id = c.comment_id where (p.user_id = #{userId} and p.del_flag = '0') or (c.user_id = #{userId} and c.del_flag = '0')
